entries.mechanism: Pinned policyengine-taxsim 2.30.0 was requested at 2026, but its Georgia siitax results have a 5.19 percent slope ((2,472.51 - 915.51) / 30,000) and imply taxable-income offsets of 12,360 single and 24,720 joint. The canonical RuleSpec instead applies the enacted 4.99 percent rate to the explicitly supplied completed Georgia taxable-net-income boundary; it constructs no deduction. For the single 30,000-dollar grid label, RuleSpec reports 748.50 and TAXSIM reports 915.51. The residual is the pinned external model vintage and boundary, not a RuleSpec computation.
